```{r}
POSITION_MAX <- c(5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 3, 5, 4, 3, 5)

random_vectors <- function(n) {
  # Total number of unique combinations possible
  max_combinations <- prod(POSITION_MAX + 1)
  if (n > max_combinations) stop(paste("n exceeds total unique combinations:", max_combinations))
  
  seen <- list()
  result <- list()
  
  while (length(result) < n) {
    candidate <- mapply(function(mx) sample(1:mx, size = 1), POSITION_MAX)
    key <- paste(candidate, collapse = "-")
    
    if (!key %in% seen) {
      seen <- c(seen, key)
      result <- c(result, list(candidate))
    }
  }
  
  result
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# the OTHER list-columns to remove (keep ReMNAU & ProportionalRep_MNIbased)
list_cols_drop <- c(
  "bone.level", "element", "One_Skeleton_count", "Skeleton_Section",
  "MNE", "MNAU", "MAU", "PercentMAU", "PercentMNAU", "AcReMNAU",
  "CumulativeReMNAU", "MNI_used_assemblage", "Mean_MNAU_assemblage",
  "Mean_part_abundance", "OverallProportionalRep_assemblage"
)

# name a row's value vector by its element labels,
# dropping slots whose label is missing/empty/purely numeric
name_by_element <- function(vec, elems) {
  v  <- setNames(vec, elems)
  nm <- names(v)
  v[!is.na(nm) & nm != "" & !grepl("^[0-9]+$", nm)]
}

tb <- tapho_db %>%
  mutate(
    ReMNAU = lapply(seq_along(ReMNAU),
                    \(i) name_by_element(ReMNAU[[i]], element[[i]])),
    ProportionalRep_MNIbased = lapply(seq_along(ProportionalRep_MNIbased),
                    \(i) name_by_element(ProportionalRep_MNIbased[[i]], element[[i]]))
  ) %>%
  select(-all_of(list_cols_drop)) %>%       # drop other list-cols, keep engineered features
  unnest_wider(c(ReMNAU, ProportionalRep_MNIbased), names_sep = "_")
tb
```

## Flexible 2D/3D RF surfaces in selected feature space

The functions below use the same cross-validated RF-ensemble idea as the PCA
surfaces, but the plotting coordinates are passed explicitly. Raw feature names
can be replaced by `"PC1"`, `"PC2"`, `"PC3"` (or `"PCA1"`, etc.) to return to
PCA coordinates.

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build group labels automatically from metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_grouped_df <- function(df, group_vars, min_group_n = 5,
                            small_groups = c("drop", "other")) {
  small_groups <- match.arg(small_groups)

  group_vars <- intersect(group_vars, names(df))
  if (length(group_vars) == 0) {
    stop("None of the requested grouping variables exist in the dataframe.")
  }

  out <- df %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(group_vars), \(x) {
      x <- as.character(x)
      x[is.na(x) | str_trim(x) == ""] <- "missing"
      x
    }))

  if (length(group_vars) == 1) {
    out <- out %>% mutate(group = .data[[group_vars[1]]])
  } else {
    out <- out %>%
      unite("group", all_of(group_vars), sep = " | ", remove = FALSE)
  }

  group_tab <- table(out$group)
  large_groups <- names(group_tab[group_tab >= min_group_n])

  if (small_groups == "drop") {
    out <- out %>% filter(group %in% large_groups)
  } else {
    out <- out %>%
      mutate(group = if_else(group %in% large_groups, group, "Other_small"))
  }

  out %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group)) %>%
    droplevels()
}

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Kruskal-Wallis + epsilon-squared + BH-FDR
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_kw_fdr <- function(df, feature_cols) {
  map_dfr(feature_cols, function(f) {
    dat <- df %>%
      transmute(group, value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[f]]))) %>%
      filter(!is.na(group), is.finite(value))

    if (n_distinct(dat$group) < 2 || nrow(dat) < 6 ||
        length(unique(dat$value)) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        feature = f,
        n = nrow(dat),
        n_groups = n_distinct(dat$group),
        H = NA_real_,
        p = NA_real_,
        eps2 = NA_real_
      ))
    }

    kt <- kruskal.test(value ~ group, data = dat)

    tibble(
      feature = f,
      n = nrow(dat),
      n_groups = n_distinct(dat$group),
      H = unname(kt$statistic),
      p = kt$p.value,
      eps2 = unname(kt$statistic) / (nrow(dat) - 1)
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
      significant = !is.na(p_fdr) & p_fdr < 0.05
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(significant), desc(eps2))
}

run_dunn_posthoc <- function(df, kw_tbl) {
  sig_features <- kw_tbl %>%
    filter(significant) %>%
    pull(feature)

  if (length(sig_features) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  map_dfr(sig_features, function(f) {
    dat <- df %>%
      transmute(group, value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[f]]))) %>%
      filter(!is.na(group), is.finite(value))

    if (n_distinct(dat$group) < 2) return(tibble())

    rstatix::dunn_test(
      dat,
      value ~ group,
      p.adjust.method = "BH"
    ) %>%
      mutate(feature = f, .before = 1)
  })
}

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. PCA / PERMANOVA cleaning
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_pca_matrix <- function(df, features, min_nonmissing = 5) {
  features <- intersect(features, names(df))
  features <- setdiff(features, bad_pca_features)

  x <- df[, features, drop = FALSE]

  x <- as.data.frame(lapply(x, function(v) {
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
    v[!is.finite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v
  }))

  for (f in intersect(log1p_pca_features, names(x))) {
    x[[f]] <- log1p(x[[f]])
  }

  keep <- names(x)[vapply(x, function(v) {
    sum(!is.na(v)) >= min_nonmissing && sd(v, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  }, logical(1))]

  x <- x[, keep, drop = FALSE]

  for (f in names(x)) {
    med <- median(x[[f]], na.rm = TRUE)
    x[[f]][is.na(x[[f]])] <- med
  }

  list(
    mat = scale(x),
    features = names(x)
  )
}

run_permanova <- function(df, features, permutations = 9999) {
  pca_ready <- clean_pca_matrix(df, features)

  if (ncol(pca_ready$mat) < 2 || n_distinct(df$group) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  vegan::adonis2(
    pca_ready$mat ~ group,
    data = df,
    method = "euclidean",
    permutations = permutations
  )
}

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Generic Plotly 3D helper
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_3d <- function(df, x, y, z, title) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[x]]),
      is.finite(.data[[y]]),
      is.finite(.data[[z]])
    )

  plot_ly(
    data = d,
    x = d[[x]],
    y = d[[y]],
    z = d[[z]],
    color = ~group,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "markers+text",
    text = ~site_name,
    textposition = "top center",
    marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.85),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    hovertext = paste0(
      "<b>", d$site_name, "</b>",
      "<br>Group: ", d$group,
      "<br>", x, ": ", round(d[[x]], 4),
      "<br>", y, ": ", round(d[[y]], 4),
      "<br>", z, ": ", round(d[[z]], 4)
    )
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = title,
      legend = list(title = list(text = "Metadata group")),
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(title = x),
        yaxis = list(title = y),
        zaxis = list(title = z)
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plot 1: automatically selected best 3 features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_best_feature_plot <- function(df, kw_tbl) {
  top3 <- kw_tbl %>%
    filter(!feature %in% bad_pca_features, !is.na(eps2)) %>%
    arrange(desc(significant), desc(eps2)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 3) %>%
    pull(feature)

  if (length(top3) < 3) {
    stop("Fewer than 3 usable features were available for the best-feature plot.")
  }

  plot_3d(
    df,
    top3[1], top3[2], top3[3],
    paste("Best 3 differential features:",
          paste(top3, collapse = " / "))
  )
}

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot 2: mean composite axes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

row_mean_safe <- function(df, cols) {
  cols <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(df)))

  x <- df[, cols, drop = FALSE]
  x <- as.data.frame(lapply(x, \(v) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))))
  m <- rowMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  m[is.nan(m)] <- NA_real_
  m
}

make_composite_df <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      completeness_axis = row_mean_safe(cur_data(), c(
        "mnau_girdle_mean",
        "mnau_shoulder",
        "mnau_proximal_appendicular_mean",
        "mnau_postcranial_total_mean",
        "mnau_appendicular_mean",
        "mnau_column_trunk_mean",
        "mnau_arms"
      )),

      pelvis_femur_proximal_axis = row_mean_safe(cur_data(), c(
        "ProportionalRep_MNIbased_os_coxae",
        "ProportionalRep_MNIbased_femur",
        "mnau_proximal_appendicular_mean",
        "mnau_girdle_mean"
      )),

      fragile_distal_survival_axis = row_mean_safe(cur_data(), c(
        "low_density_survival_index",
        "ProportionalRep_MNIbased_metacarpal",
        "mnau_distal_appendicular_mean",
        "ReMNAU_cervical"
      ))
    )
}

make_composite_plot <- function(df) {
  comp_df <- make_composite_df(df)

  plot_3d(
    comp_df,
    "completeness_axis",
    "pelvis_femur_proximal_axis",
    "fragile_distal_survival_axis",
    "3D composite plot: completeness / pelvis-femur-proximal / fragile-distal survival"
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Plot 3: 3D PCA plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

make_pca_plot <- function(df, kw_tbl) {
  pca_features <- kw_tbl %>%
    filter(significant, !feature %in% bad_pca_features) %>%
    arrange(desc(eps2)) %>%
    pull(feature)

  if (length(pca_features) < 3) {
    pca_features <- kw_tbl %>%
      filter(!is.na(eps2), !feature %in% bad_pca_features) %>%
      arrange(desc(eps2)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 8) %>%
      pull(feature)
  }

  pca_ready <- clean_pca_matrix(df, pca_features)

  if (ncol(pca_ready$mat) < 3) {
    stop("PCA needs at least 3 usable features after cleaning.")
  }

  pca <- prcomp(pca_ready$mat, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

  scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:3, drop = FALSE]) %>%
    bind_cols(df %>% select(site_name, group), .)

  pca_var <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:3] * 100

  plot_ly(
    data = scores,
    x = ~PC1,
    y = ~PC2,
    z = ~PC3,
    color = ~group,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "markers+text",
    text = ~site_name,
    textposition = "top center",
    marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.85),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    hovertext = ~paste0(
      "<b>", site_name, "</b>",
      "<br>Group: ", group,
      "<br>PC1: ", round(PC1, 3),
      "<br>PC2: ", round(PC2, 3),
      "<br>PC3: ", round(PC3, 3)
    )
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = "3D PCA of automatically selected skeletal-representation features",
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_var[1], 1), "%)")),
        yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_var[2], 1), "%)")),
        zaxis = list(title = paste0("PC3 (", round(pca_var[3], 1), "%)"))
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Full analysis for one grouping
# ------------------------------------------------------------

analyse_grouping <- function(tb, group_vars, feature_cols,
                             min_group_n = 5,
                             small_groups = "drop") {
  grouped_df <- make_grouped_df(
    tb,
    group_vars = group_vars,
    min_group_n = min_group_n,
    small_groups = small_groups
  )

  if (n_distinct(grouped_df$group) < 2) {
    stop("This grouping leaves fewer than two usable groups.")
  }

  kw_tbl <- run_kw_fdr(grouped_df, feature_cols)
  dunn_tbl <- run_dunn_posthoc(grouped_df, kw_tbl)

  p_best <- make_best_feature_plot(grouped_df, kw_tbl)
  p_comp <- make_composite_plot(grouped_df)
  p_pca  <- make_pca_plot(grouped_df, kw_tbl)

  permanova_tbl <- run_permanova(
    grouped_df,
    kw_tbl %>%
      filter(significant) %>%
      pull(feature)
  )

  list(
    grouped_data = grouped_df,
    kw_results = kw_tbl,
    dunn_results = dunn_tbl,
    permanova = permanova_tbl,
    plots = list(
      best_features_3d = p_best,
      composite_3d = p_comp,
      pca_3d = p_pca
    )
  )
}

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Screen candidate groupings, then choose one
# ------------------------------------------------------------

max_or_na <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

screen_groupings <- function(tb, candidate_groupings, feature_cols,
                             min_group_n = 5) {
  imap_dfr(candidate_groupings, function(vars, nm) {
    tryCatch({
      grouped_df <- make_grouped_df(
        tb,
        group_vars = vars,
        min_group_n = min_group_n,
        small_groups = "drop"
      )

      if (n_distinct(grouped_df$group) < 2) {
        stop("fewer than two usable groups")
      }

      kw_tbl <- run_kw_fdr(grouped_df, feature_cols)

      perm <- tryCatch(
        run_permanova(
          grouped_df,
          kw_tbl %>%
            filter(significant) %>%
            pull(feature)
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      tibble(
        hypothesis = nm,
        group_vars = paste(vars, collapse = " + "),
        n_rows = nrow(grouped_df),
        n_groups = n_distinct(grouped_df$group),
        n_significant_features = sum(kw_tbl$significant, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_eps2 = max_or_na(kw_tbl$eps2),
        top_3_features = paste(
          kw_tbl %>%
            filter(!is.na(eps2)) %>%
            arrange(desc(eps2)) %>%
            slice_head(n = 3) %>%
            pull(feature),
          collapse = ", "
        ),
        permanova_R2 = if (!is.null(perm)) perm$R2[1] else NA_real_,
        permanova_p = if (!is.null(perm)) perm$`Pr(>F)`[1] else NA_real_,
        error = NA_character_
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      tibble(
        hypothesis = nm,
        group_vars = paste(vars, collapse = " + "),
        n_rows = NA_integer_,
        n_groups = NA_integer_,
        n_significant_features = NA_integer_,
        max_eps2 = NA_real_,
        top_3_features = NA_character_,
        permanova_R2 = NA_real_,
        permanova_p = NA_real_,
        error = conditionMessage(e)
      )
    })
  }) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_significant_features), desc(max_eps2))
}
```




```{r}

  tb,
  candidate_groupings,
  feature_cols,
  min_group_n = 5
)
```
